Araceae.key_door: two-door family: ordinary spathe/spadix aroids vs highly reduced duckweeds; Lemna 1 root, Spirodela many roots, Wolffia rootless

Hydrocharitaceae.key_door: Vallisneria: submerged ribbon rosette + floating detached male flowers + female surface flower on long coiling peduncle + inferior ovary

anchor_families.Alismataceae: basal aquatic rosette + emergent 3-part flowers + achene heads
anchor_families.Potamogetonaceae: leafy submerged stems + axillary stipule/prophyll + emergent flower spike

taxonomy_notes: Modern Kew places Lemna, Spirodela and Wolffia in Araceae; older FNA treats them under Lemnaceae and remains useful for morphological keys.
Source Spirodela polyrrhiza is normalized to current accepted spelling Spirodela polyrhiza.
Amorphophallus titanum is accepted but a western-Sumatran nonlocal comparison.
Vallisneria americana remains accepted; FNA and current Kew display different distribution treatments, so Texas/Hays range resolution remains in the species workflow.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not require an obvious spathe/spadix in duckweeds because that lineage is extremely reduced.
Do not use family-level work to settle Pistia or Vallisneria native/invasive status.
